meta.title: Endfield Industries Boot Sequence
meta.description: A full-screen Endfield Industries secure boot layer for DeepSeek Harness: a centered logo sweep that flies into the corner, charcoal/signal-yellow hard-edged HUD, bilingual UI, Edge Aria female voice, and a user-driven ENDMINISTRATOR gate with a 6-second re-confirmation countdown and one-per-second permission auto-scan.
